primaryIsa.name: Tier1 Architectures
primaryIsa.description: "Tier1 Architectures" are the architectures we support at the highest level. You'll get the latest updates and all the features, plus it's the most closely watched by maintainers and thoroughly tested.

secondaryIsa.name: Tier2 Architectures
secondaryIsa.description: "Tier2 Architectures" supports most features, however the scarcity of devices, poorer performance, or lower maintainer engagement means that aside from timely security updates, other updates, testing, and feedback may not be as comprehensive as our Tier 1 architectures

aoscOsIsaInfoPrimary: For x86 devices compatible with AMD64 or Intel 64 instruction set extensions
For 64-bit Arm devices compatible with Armv8-A and above
For 64-bit devices compatible with the LoongArch instruction set and 128-bit vector extensions (LSX)
aoscOsIsaInfoSecondary: For 64-bit, little-endian devices compatible with Power ISA v2.07 and above
For 64-bit RISC-V devices compatible with the RVA20 Architecture Profile
For Loongson-3 devices based on MIPS
afterglowIsaInfoPrimary: For 32-bit x86 devices compatible with i486 (Intel486)
For Loongson-2 (2F) devices based on MIPS with LoongMMI instruction set extensions
For 32-bit big-endian devices compatible with the PowerPC instruction set (IBM CHRP/PReP, Apple Macintosh, and compatible platforms)
afterglowIsaInfoSecondary: For Arm devices compatible with the ARMv4 instruction set
For Arm devices compatible with the ARMv6 instruction set and Thumb-2/NEON extensions
For Arm devices compatible with the ARMv7 instruction set and Thumb-2/NEON extensions
For devices based on the DEC Alpha (formerly Alpha AXP) instruction set architecture
For devices compatible with the IA-64 instruction set architecture (Itanium)
For devices compatible with Motorola 68020 and equipped with a Memory Management Unit (MMU)
For 64-bit big-endian devices compatible with the PowerPC instruction set (IBM CHRP/PReP, Apple Macintosh, and compatible platforms)
For 64-bit SPARC devices compatible with the SPARC V9 instruction set and VIS 1.0 extensions
